headline: Juniper Industries wins quality award from industry association
body: Juniper Industries received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Juniper Industries publishes annual sustainability report
body: Juniper Industries released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Juniper Industries reports minor shipment delays at Austin plant
body: Juniper Industries confirmed shipment delays of several days at its Austin plant due to a equipment maintenance backlog. The company said deliveries should normalize within weeks.

headline: Juniper Industries opens new production line in Austin
body: Juniper Industries commissioned a new line at its Austin site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.
